Private Luxury Retreats For Robust Wellness, Burnout Recovery & Mental Health Healing

Since 2009, Alive has been recognised as one of the world’s leading holistic wellness and mental health retreats, known for delivering deeply personalised, results driven transformation for the whole person.
This is not a typical retreat experience. Every stay is fully private, one on one, and designed entirely around you. Your health, your mind, your life, and what needs to change.

Your dedicated expert team delivers a complete 360 approach, integrating advanced health and wellness, detox and physical restoration, burnout recovery, and intensive mental health retreats. Each element is carefully tailored to help you reset, regain clarity, and move forward with strength and direction in record time, using a proven system.

Join us at our luxury private beachfront retreat in Bali. Your experience is available year round in your very own 5 star private villas designed for complete confidentiality, support, and lasting change.
